title: SCHC retransmissions silently evict other sessions' unsent wire capabilities
description: Security codereview finding in python/src/lichen/schc/fragment.py: _issue_fragment_wire_unlocked inserts each one-use _IssuedFragmentWire into a global OrderedDict and blindly popitem(last=False) above MAX_ISSUED_FRAGMENT_WIRES. The cap equals only the maximum initial output for 64 two-window sessions (64*126); any ACK-driven repair/retransmission while that legitimate capacity is outstanding evicts another live session's unsent authority. Its later LinkLayer.send fails as stale, so one receiver controlling negative ACK timing can cause cross-peer transfer failures. Never silently evict a live issued capability: reserve/budget per active session including maximum repair output, consume/revoke deterministically, or fail the requesting transition atomically without harming other sessions; add saturated multi-peer repair regression.
